title: Create, then dispatch a StratoNext task
description: Creates a StratoNext task, then dispatches it from a second node that reads taskId from the first: drop an approval node between the two to gate dispatch. Takes the same inputs as "Dispatch a StratoNext task": name, description, optional instructions, project and agent.

name.title: Task name
name.description: Short name for the task, shown in StratoNext and in the Port catalog.

description.title: Description
description.description: What the agent should achieve. Give it enough context to know what done looks like.

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.description: Optional step-by-step instructions for the agent. Leave empty to let it plan its own approach.

project.title: Project
project.description: Optional StratoNext project to file the task under.

agent.title: Agent
agent.description: Optional StratoNext agent to assign the task to. Leave empty to omit the assignee.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: StratoNext workspace to create the task in. Optional when a project is chosen: the project's workspace is used.

title: Cancel a StratoNext task
description: Cancels a StratoNext task that is queued or already running. Asks only for the id of the task to cancel.

taskId.title: Task ID
taskId.description: Identifier of the StratoNext task to cancel: the taskId a dispatch run returns, or the identifier of its StratoNext Task entity in the catalog.

title: Create an AWS cost report
description: Dispatches a StratoNext agent to produce a read-only AWS cost report for one environment, broken down by service, against the preceding period. Asks for the environment, how far back to look, the Cost Explorer granularity and the agent to run it: the task instructions are fixed.

environment.title: AWS environment
environment.description: StratoNext environment to report on: the agent assumes its operations role to reach Cost Explorer.

lookbackDays.title: Look back (days)
lookbackDays.description: How far back Cost Explorer is queried. The preceding period of the same length is used for comparison.

granularity.title: Granularity
granularity.description: Cost Explorer bucket size for the query: daily or monthly.

agent.title: Agent
agent.description: StratoNext agent that runs the report.

body.name: AWS cost report: last {{ .outputs.trigger.lookbackDays }} days
body.description: Produce an AWS cost report for this environment, broken down by service, with period-over-period comparison and anomaly callouts.
body.instructions:
Produce an AWS cost report for the target environment.

1. Resolve the environment from the task's environmentIds and assume its AgentOperationsRoleArn (with AgentOperationsExternalId if present) before any AWS call.
2. Query Cost Explorer (ce:GetCostAndUsage) for the last {{ .outputs.trigger.lookbackDays }} days at {{ .outputs.trigger.granularity }} granularity, grouped by SERVICE, using UnblendedCost.
3. Report:
   - total spend for the period, and the same figure for the preceding period
   - the top 5 services by spend, each with its share of the total
   - any service whose spend moved more than 25% against the preceding period
   - untagged or unattributed spend, if any
4. Call out anything that looks anomalous, with the evidence you based it on. Do not speculate beyond what the data shows.
5. Post the report as the task result, as markdown with a table for the per-service breakdown.

This is a read-only task. Do not create, modify, or delete any AWS resource. If a required permission is missing, stop and request approval rather than working around it.
body.verificationCriteria: The task result contains a per-service AWS cost breakdown for the requested period, a period total compared against the preceding period, and the top 5 services by spend.
